correctness.rationale: For a prescribed containment flag S⊆X, the two-sided zero condition descends the product to V/S. In a basis adapted to X/S, vanishing commutator entries require one condition per cross-block pair and one per unordered pair within X/S, none on the diagonal. These entries are independently specifiable via upper-triangular bilinear coefficients even in characteristic two, which gives D_r(a,b). A map onto W is an ordered independent s-tuple of scalar forms in that D-dimensional space, giving F_q, including zero when D<s. First invert the center containment over X⊇U_0 with annihilator containment S held fixed; after forcing U=U_0 all annihilator subspaces lie inside U_0. Invert there over S⊇T_0; each pair satisfies S⊆X. The Gaussian multiplicities count those possible extensions and the factor outside the sum counts prescribed flags. Every surjection has one exact flag, yielding normalization, including the r=1 and full image-rank boundary cases. A fixed center line has codimension r−1 in scalar forms, and a fixed center plane codimension 2r−3. Relative to the line first moment, the sum of pair probabilities is O(q^(r−s(r−2))) and tends to zero for s≥2. The annihilator codimensions are 2r−1 and 4r−4, giving ratio O(q^(r−s(2r−3))). The asymptotic probabilities then follow by Bonferroni, and T⊆U gives the claimed quotient q^(−sr). Alternating forms have even rank in characteristic two as well as odd characteristic, proving the odd-r one-output case. The uploaded prime-field checker was inspected, not executed. Independent direct scalar multiplication and vector tests over GF(4), r=2, gave dimension-pair bins (0,0):192, (0,2):48, (1,2):15 for s=1 and (0,0):60480, (0,2):3780 for s=2, matching the exact counts (python /workspace/review-evidence/independent_checks.py). The exhaustive checks are only finite corroboration.
